source_name: BQK — Vendimet e Bordit Ekzekutiv / Decisions of the Executive Board
why_relevant: BQK Executive Board decisions are the legally mandated act by which bank/MFI/NBFI/PSP licences, preliminary approvals and (per licensing manuals) senior-management and board approvals are granted. Individual dated decision posts name institutions and, in many cases, the approved persons or the licence action behind a leadership move.

source_name: Ligji Nr. 08/L-304 për Bankat (2026 new Banking Law, as published)
why_relevant: The newly enacted banking law (Official Gazette Nr.2, 27 Jan 2026) resets fit-and-proper, board-approval and licence-revocation rules. Any change in what CBK must approve or publish about bank management flows from this text; it also signals a wave of re-approvals across the sector.

source_name: BQK — 'Bank Directors and Senior Managers' supervisory instruction/form
why_relevant: Defines who counts as a director/senior manager subject to CBK fit-and-proper approval (CEO, deputy CEO, CFO, COO, CRO and others CBK designates). This is the schema that tells a collector which roles legally generate a public CBK approval event — essential for scoping A5 leadership-move monitoring.

source_name: BQK — Rregullore për Qeverisjen Korporative të Bankave (corporate governance regulation)
why_relevant: The binding rule on bank board composition, committee structure, independence and management appointment/notification duties. It defines what an entity must disclose and when — i.e. the legal trigger list for every leadership/organization event this workstream should expect to see.

source_name: BQK — Manuali i Licencimit Bankar / Banking Licensing Manual (sq + en)
why_relevant: Sets the procedure and 90-day deadlines for licence decisions and the documentation required for proposed directors and senior managers. Gives the expected lag between an appointment and its public CBK record — the timing model for the monitoring pipeline.

source_name: BQK — Ligji për Sistemin e Pagesave / Law on Payment System (04/L-155)
why_relevant: Establishes CBK licensing and oversight of payment-system operators and payment institutions, including the requirements applying to their management. This is the statutory hook that makes payments-sector leadership moves a published regulatory event rather than private corporate news.

source_name: BQK — Manuali i Regjistrimit të Institucioneve Mikrofinanciare dhe IFJB
why_relevant: Non-bank leg of the same regime: registration/approval procedure for MFIs and non-bank financial institutions (which in Kosovo include many payment/FX actors), including management-approval requirements. Extends A5 coverage beyond banks into the payments-adjacent institution set.

source_name: BQK — Rregullore për licencimin e operatorëve të kripto-aseteve (crypto-asset operator licensing)
why_relevant: A new licensing category (2025) means a new stream of CBK approvals covering management fit-and-proper for crypto/payments-adjacent operators, plus a likely new supervisory unit and hiring at CBK. Marks an expanding perimeter for A5 leadership-move records.

entity_name: Ministria e Financave, Punës dhe Transfereve
source_name: Gjykata Komerciale e Kosovës (Commercial Court) — decisions and case register
why_relevant: Established by Law 08/L-015, the Commercial Court hears company, commercial and registration disputes — including challenges to registry entries, shareholder disputes and director removals. Its published decisions name officers and expose organisation changes that are contested rather than merely filed.

entity_name: Ministria e Financave, Punës dhe Transfereve
source_name: Draft Law on Payment Services (Projektligji për Shërbimet e Pagesave) — Office of the Prime Minister
why_relevant: The PSD2-style payment services law reshapes who may operate as a payment institution / PSP in Kosovo. Regulatory openings drive a wave of new licensed entities and of compliance/PCI/AML/open-banking hiring — an early leading indicator for the payments employer landscape, plus a canonical source of the legal terminology used in job ads.

source_name: SHBK — Periodiku Bankar (banking periodical, PDF series)
why_relevant: The association's periodical carries bank-by-bank news pages that routinely announce new CEOs, board appointments and departmental reorganisations, plus signed articles that reveal who holds which functional role (payments, cards, digital) inside each member bank.

source_name: ProCredit Bank Kosova — Annual Report PDF series
why_relevant: Annual reports narrate organizational changes, headcount, staff-development spend and board composition for the Kosovo unit — the densest single artefact for A5 structural/HR intelligence.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Kosovo — RISE internship & scholarship programme news
why_relevant: RISE is an explicit university-to-bank pipeline (scholarships + internships for technology/IT students, ~15 per cohort, agile-methodology training). Cohort size and disciplines are a direct, dated signal of planned IT/digital headcount growth at one of Kosovo's largest banks.

source_name: The Banker (FT) — Bank of the Year Awards, Kosovo country winner
why_relevant: Annual country award. Award citations and the bank's own press release quote the accepting executive by name and title, and the citation text describes strategy shifts (new card offering, sustainability programme) that precede reorganisations. The winner's press release is often more accessible than The Banker's paywalled page.

source_name: IMF eLibrary — Kosovo Financial Sector Stability Review (technical assistance report)
why_relevant: TA report detail on supervisory resourcing, staffing gaps and organisational structure at the Central Bank of Kosovo — direct evidence of institutional org/hiring pressure.

source_name: Vreme (sr) — reporting on payment-transaction regime affecting Kosovo Serb community
why_relevant: The only substantive Serbian-language thread found for this cell: coverage of Kosovo curtailing dinar payment traffic ('platni promet') with central Serbia, including the reported closure of NLB Komercijalna's nine Kosovo branches. Such regime changes destroy and create payments jobs in northern municipalities and force PSP/branch reorganisations — a leading indicator for organization-change signals on the Serbian-language side.

source_name: AIK Banka — scholarships for students in Kosovo and Metohija (sr)
why_relevant: The only Serbian-language bank-to-student pipeline programme surfaced for the Kosovo territory: AIK Banka awards scholarships to top students in Kosovo and Metohija, i.e. the University of Priština (temporary seat in Kosovska Mitrovica) catchment. Covers the Serb-majority north that Albanian-language sources miss entirely.

source_name: Compass Plus Technologies — customer success stories (Quipu processing case study)
why_relevant: A card-processing vendor's published case study on Quipu documents the processing platform behind ProCredit's Kosovo card operations. Case-study pages are exactly the 'supplier announces the win' artefact the cell targets, and they date the underlying platform decision.

source_name: European Cluster Collaboration Platform — STIKK organisation profile
why_relevant: EU-run registry profile of STIKK giving an independently maintained description, contact person and membership scale — useful as a cross-check on association self-reported figures and as a discovery route to other Kosovo clusters/associations listed on the same platform.

source_name: KOBIL — ProCredit Bank / Quipu success story (security vendor case study)
why_relevant: Security-vendor case study naming ProCredit/Quipu and the modernisation of online-banking authentication. Cybersecurity vendors are among the most willing to publish named bank references, making them a reliable indirect channel into Kosovo bank technology and org change.

source_name: Këshilla Ligjore — guides to finding Kosovo business information / Commercial Court
why_relevant: Albanian-language practitioner guides that enumerate which Kosovo registers exist and how to obtain company information, including officer data — a compact local-language map of the registry landscape that surfaces portals not visible in English search.

source_name: Open Contracting Partnership — Kosovo procurement data assessment
why_relevant: Documents exactly what structured data Kosovo's procurement platform exposes (procurement plans, tender dossiers, signed contract PDFs, contract implementation cards, bidder/buyer/supplier/value fields, 31,000+ tender records) and where coverage is weak. Essentially a specification for building an automated collector against e-Prokurimi.

source_name: OpenCorporates — Kosovo Business Registration Agency register profile
why_relevant: Documents the Kosovo register's openness profile: freely searchable but scoring 15/100 on the Open Company Data Index, with officers, directors, shareholders and accounts recorded as NOT available in bulk/open form. Critical for calibrating expectations and for justifying reliance on per-entity extracts rather than open data.
